newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's credit to private sector up 32 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Peru's credit to private sector up 32 pct in 1996.

text.p: Credit from Peru's banking system to the private sector stood at 29.325 billion soles at the end of 1996, up 32 percent in real terms from the previous year, the Central Reserve Bank said Monday.
In nominal terms, credit was up 48.2 percent by the end of last year from 19.873 billion at the close of 1995.
"The private sector credit in 1996 represented the equivalent of 16.6 percent of gross domestic product ... the highest level in the last 30 years," the bank said in its weekly report.
Local currency loans to the private sector totalled 7.556 billion soles at the end of 1996, while foreign currency loans were $8.373 billion.
